unit_label: Section 2: Hilfssatz ueber algebraisch abhaengige Funktionen
translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice; English control slice reserved only as a sanity witness.

technical_exclusions.disposition: Section 3 and later content; not included in this checkpoint

segment_summaries.content: Section heading for the auxiliary lemma on algebraically dependent functions.
segment_summaries.choices: Hilfssatz rendered as lemma rather than proposition; the relation to Section 3 remains explicit.

segment_summaries.content: Purpose statement: the lemma will show that algebraic rank is the characteristic number; controlled numerical specialization preserves algebraic independence and avoids identically zero or undefined specialization of dependent functions.
segment_summaries.choices: Unbestimmte kept as indeterminates; unbestimmt werden translated as become undefined/indeterminate, not as becoming an indeterminate.

segment_summaries.content: Set-up of the system g_1,...,g_rho, the rational function h, the rank of the functional matrix, and the nonzero Jacobian-style determinant Gamma/G^(rho+1).
segment_summaries.choices: Funktionalmatrix translated literally as functional matrix rather than silently modernizing to Jacobian matrix.

segment_summaries.content: Choice of a numerical value a so that G·Gamma is not divisible by x_i-a; the common denominator cannot vanish and algebraic rank is preserved by substitution.
segment_summaries.choices: Preserved the divisibility language because the proof turns on polynomial divisibility after specialization.

segment_summaries.content: Irreducible equation for h over the g_i, conversion to a polynomial identity by writing g_i=G_i:G and h=H_1:H_2 in reduced representation.
segment_summaries.choices: Interslavic uses nerazložimo jednačenje, aligned with the earlier Paper 05 irreducible-equation lane; reduced representation remains redukovano predstavjenje.

segment_summaries.content: Contradiction argument: if H_1 were divisible by x_i-a, then divisibility of B_tau and A_tau would force a relation among the specialized independent functions; the footnote explains why simultaneous substitution can create 0/0.
segment_summaries.choices: Kept the 0/0 warning explicit and preserved the example rather than compressing the proof.

segment_summaries.content: Iteration statement: the same argument applies after each reduced specialization.
segment_summaries.choices: Procedure/continuation language kept close to source to bridge into the formal lemma.

segment_summaries.content: Formal auxiliary lemma: under rank-preserving successive substitutions, the final h* has neither numerator nor denominator identically zero and does not become 0/0.
segment_summaries.choices: Italic theorem environment and the successive-substitution display are preserved in all four rendered readers.

Review Interslavic `neopreděljena` versus `prěměnna` consistently where German distinguishes Unbestimmte from ordinary variables.
Review Interslavic `sohranjen` preservation vocabulary against `zachovany`; current choice follows prior lane usage but remains a terminology-log item.
